# Outgoing XRAS responses

Captured on XRAS-dev 2026-10-27 (`docs/plans/XRAS_SUBMISSION_SPRINT1.md` § 9): the full body of
`POST /v1/requests?opportunityId=<id>&requestType=New` as benkirk, one per opportunity. The
person block is redacted (example email, no phone). Both drafts were soft-deleted afterwards, so
the ids resolve to nothing. The request's `rules{}` carries no resource list; the opportunity's
does.
